description: This file defines the EnforcementConfig interface which provides configuration settings for concierge enforcement behavior within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to retrieve timeout durations, buffer sizes, and dispatching flags, along with an inner enum for known configuration values and their defaults.

classes.name: EnforcementConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration settings related to enforcement behavior in the concierge service.

classes.name: EnforcementConfig.EnforcementConfigValue
classes.description: An enum defining known configuration keys and their default values for EnforcementConfig.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait for entity shard regions.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the buffer size used for the queue in the enforcer actor.

methods.name: shouldDispatchLiveResponsesGlobally
methods.description: Returns whether live responses from channels other than their subscribers should be dispatched.
